name: Wendigo
ability: Bury a Town Card. If now there's at least 6 cards in the graveyard, also gain 2 fear. If 11 cards, also draw two cards. If 16, also inflict 2 suspicion.

name: Mothman
ability: Pick a number. Bury all town cards with that cost, then based on the amount buried: (1,2) Gain 2 Fear, (3) Gain 4, (4) Inflict 5 Suspicion, (5) Inflict 7, (6) Inflict 10.

name: Flatwoods Monster
modifier: At the start of the game, shuffle the drone deck and place it face-down near the shop. Whenever a drone is buried, return it to the drone deck.
ability: Bury every drone in your hand. For each erased, choose: draw two cards, or gain 3 fear, or inflict 2 suspicion.

name: Loveland Frogman
modifier: At the start of the game, take your Magic Die and place it in a convenient location.
ability: Roll the die. If it lands on 1-3, get that amount of Fear. 4-5, draw two cards. 6, self-inflict 2 Suspicion. Any other number - roll again.
